jobs.description:
Description

Harmar is a leading manufacturer of mobility and accessibility products, including automobile wheelchair lifts, stair lifts, and residential and commercial vertical platform lifts. We are inspired by the people we serve and driven to create products that help individuals go where they want, when they want, and how they want.

Thanks to our people, Harmar is proud to be Great Place to Work® Certified™. Our culture and the employee experience are business priorities.

Non-negotiable Experience

This role requires substantial, hands-on new product development (NPD) leadership and the ability to run the day-to-day engineering function with precision. This is not a strategy-only position; candidates must be equally strong at setting direction and driving disciplined execution.

The Opportunity

The Director of Engineering leads Harmar's design engineering organization and is accountable for both new product growth and dependable daily execution. This leader will translate the voice of the customer and business strategy into a compelling, manufacturable product portfolio while ensuring that engineering priorities, resources, schedules, risks, documentation, and deliverables are actively managed every day.

The successful candidate is a detail-oriented operator who stays close to the work, creates clear accountability, and follows initiatives through to completion. The role owns NPD, new product introductions, sustaining engineering, cost reduction, technology research, and lifecycle product support in close partnership with Product Management, Operations, Quality, Supply Chain, Sales, and executive leadership.

What Success Looks Like

NPD execution: A reliable development pipeline that moves products from customer need and concept through design, verification/validation, industrialization, launch, and post-launch support.
Sustaining execution: A ranked sustaining system that moves savings, customer needs and manufacturing improvements through design, verification/validation, industrialization, launch, and post-launch support.
Daily operating discipline: Clear priorities, realistic schedules, visible metrics, timely decisions, and rigorous follow-through across the engineering portfolio.
Design quality and manufacturability: Products that meet specifications and customer needs while achieving quality, cost, manufacturability, serviceability, and compliance targets.
Team performance: An accountable, collaborative engineering team with strong technical depth, clear expectations, and a continuous-improvement mindset.

Key Responsibilities

Own the NPD portfolio. Lead multiple new product programs from concept through commercial launch, establishing scope, stage-gate expectations, schedules, budgets, resources, technical requirements, product cost targets, and quality objectives. Own the Engineering of all NPD programs.
Run engineering day to day. Establish the operating cadence for priorities, project reviews, resource allocation, issue escalation, risk management, and performance metrics; ensure commitments are specific, documented, tracked, and completed.
Maintain technical and execution rigor. Review designs, specifications, calculations, drawings, bills of material, test plans, design reviews, and project documentation with close attention to accuracy, completeness, and change control.
Design for the factory and the customer. Partner with Operations, Quality, Supply Chain, Service, and Product Management to build manufacturability, reliability, serviceability, cost, and customer requirements into each product.
Lead sustaining engineering. Balance NPD with lifecycle support, quality improvements, cost reduction, value engineering, technical problem-solving, and timely response to production and field issues.
Build a high-performing team. Set objectives, clarify roles, coach and develop talent, manage performance, plan succession, and create a culture of ownership, urgency, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
Shape the product roadmap. Partner with executive leadership and Product Management team to translate customer insight, competitive intelligence, emerging technology, and commercial opportunities into a focused development roadmap.
Communicate with clarity. Provide concise, fact-based updates on portfolio status, resource needs, tradeoffs, risks, decisions, and results to executive and cross-functional stakeholders

Requirements

Required Qualifications

Demonstrated NPD leadership is required. Substantial, hands-on experience leading engineered products through the full development lifecycle—from customer need and concept through design, verification/validation, manufacturing release, launch, and post-launch support. Candidates without this experience will not be considered.
Proven engineering operations leadership is required. Experience running the daily work of an engineering function, including portfolio prioritization, project controls, schedules, resources, metrics, risk management, design reviews, documentation, and issue resolution.
Exceptional attention to detail and follow-through. A consistent record of identifying gaps, asking the next question, maintaining accurate project and technical information, and ensuring commitments are completed to standard.
Experience. At least 10 years of progressive engineering experience, including at least 7 years leading NPD and sustaining engineering teams in a manufactured-products environment.
Education. Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
Leadership. Strong people-management, cross-functional influence, business judgment, and executive communication skills.

Preferred Experience

Engineering leadership in mobility, medical, industrial, durable, or other complex manufactured products.
Experience operating within a formal quality system and working with applicable product safety or regulatory requirements.
Track record of improving product development processes, engineering metrics, time to market, product cost, and launch performance.

jobs.title: Director, Growth Engineering
jobs.description:
ABOUT OnX

We’re a team of builders, adventurers, and risk takers using technology to help people confidently explore the outdoors. Driven by our mission to awaken the adventurer inside everyone, we build products that optimize every outdoor experience and inspire confidence to get out and go further.

We’re a high-growth tech company. The pace is fast, the work takes grit, and ambiguity is part of the job. As the world changes around us, we adapt - continuously evolving how we build, prioritize, and deliver.

Our business moves quickly, and there’s real opportunity to shape what we build next. Each of our verticals - Hunt, Offroad, Backcountry, and Fish - is at a different stage of maturity, which means the challenges you encounter and the impact you have will vary depending on where you sit and what the business needs most.

We operate with an experimentation mindset, continually iterating and improving how we solve problems. We expect our people to use the latest tooling, including AI, thoughtfully and responsibly, pairing human judgment with technology to increase quality, speed, and impact.

Our impact comes to life through the products we build, in the stories of our customers, and in our growing commitment to land stewardship and recreational access.

About This Opportunity

The Director of Growth Engineering will lead the Growth engineering teams with strong partnership with growth product, overseeing all software engineering efforts dedicated to driving user acquisition, activation, and conversion across iOS, Android, and Web platforms. This role is a critical blend of strategic vision, technical leadership, and cross-functional collaboration aimed at scaling our growth platform and services to maximize User Acquisition, Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) and user lifetime value while maintaining engineering standards and excellence.

What You'll Do

Essential Job Duties & Functions

Strategic Engineering Leadership

Define and articulate a multi-year Growth Engineering Strategy aligned with corporate goals such as new market entry and feature expansion.
Facilitate long-term engineering strategies in partnership with the Product organization.
Collaborate with Marketing to develop and optimize the marketing technology stack strategy.
Champion an innovation-led culture focused on A/B testing infrastructure and rapid experimentation to optimize the conversion funnel.

Technical Oversight & Architecture

Oversee the design and evolution of highly available, secure growth foundational systems
Push for more scalable and maintainable future systems within the Growth teams and establish technical standards.
Drive the development of personalization engineering, including User Personalization systems.
Bridge the gap between Growth data and Data Engineering/BI to improve data warehousing and business metric reporting.
Own the SDLC and enable and execute on solid foundations for operational excellence.

Team Management & Development

Lead and evolve a team of Engineering Managers and Software Engineers across multiple platforms: backend, mobile, and Web.
Mentor and coach technical leaders while driving hiring, performance reviews, and career progression plans.
Educate the team on growth strategies and building future-proof technical solutions.
Refine the Growth-domain career ladder to ensure alignment with broader engineering leveling.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Partner closely with User Acquisition (UA) and Marketing Automation (MA) teams to align engineering deliverables with campaign goals.
Coordinate with Data Engineering and Business Intelligence to ensure accurate measurements of growth funnel events to downstream reporting and analysis.
Partner with vertical Product and Engineering leads to ensure horizontal Growth initiatives integrate seamlessly with the overall product roadmap.

What You’ll Bring

Proven experience at least 4+ years in technical leadership across growth teams, specifically within mobile and web environments.
Strong background in technical solutions involving marketing, product, and engineering teams.
Track record instituting sound SDLC practices (testing, code review, incident response, observability) in high-velocity environment, can balance speed with system quality
Expertise in managing complex subscription lifecycles and payment integration systems.
Ability to act as a multiplier for teams, proactively identifying and owning areas of improvement.
Deep understanding of experimentation methodologies, including A/B testing and instrumentation.
A strong curiosity for exploring new technologies, including AI
A shared passion for and ability to demonstrate onX’s Company Values.
Permanent US work authorization is a condition of employment with onX.
Ability to travel quarterly for multiple days to a corporate office or other onX strategic location, such as a Basecamp.

ADDED BONUSES

Though not required, we would be thrilled to consider candidates with any of the following:

Experience working and integrating with user attribution and marketing automation technologies
Experience with analytics technology that tracks and reports website and app traffic, user behavior, and visitor data
Experience with reporting tools like Tableau, Looker, etc.

The Onx Experience

onX is a distributed company with more than 400 employees across the country. We come together regularly to work in person and stay connected through regional basecamps and a culture that balances individual ownership with deep collaboration.

While we move quickly, we’re not a scrappy start-up. We operate with clear goals, structure, and frameworks that guide how we prioritize and execute. Priorities matter. While they may shift, data shapes how we evolve as our business, products, and the world around us change.

Clear priorities and structure don’t limit ownership - they make it possible. You’ll have the autonomy to define your work and make meaningful decisions within clear strategic boundaries. You’ll partner closely with others to solve complex problems and build solutions that scale across teams and platforms. Along the way, you’ll be supported with feedback, tools, and opportunities to grow your craft as you take on new challenges.

WHERE YOU CAN WORK

onX has created a thriving distributed workforce designed to foster connection, collaboration, and shared experience across several US locations. We have two HQ locations in Bozeman and Missoula, MT and established virtual workforce Basecamps in Austin, TX; Denver, CO; Kalispell, MT; Minneapolis, MN; Portland, OR; Salt Lake City, UT; and Seattle, WA.

How You’ll Be Compensated

onX is committed to compensating all employees fairly and equitably for their contributions. For this position, applicants can expect to make between $200,000 and $249,000 upon hire. The pay range will vary based upon experience, skills, certifications, education, among other factors as required in the job description. In addition, full-time onX employees are eligible for a grant of common share options with a vesting schedule and an annual bonus of 10% based on company performance.

What We’re Offering You

Competitive salaries, annual bonuses, equity, and opportunities for growth
Comprehensive health benefits, including a no-monthly-cost medical plan
Paid parental leave of 13 weeks for birthing parents and 5 weeks for non-birthing parents
401k matching at 100% for the first 3% you save and 50% from 3-5%
Company-wide outdoor adventures and amazing outdoor industry perks
Annual “Get Out, Get Active” funds to fuel your active lifestyle
Flexible time away package that includes PTO, STO, VTO, and paid holidays

Performance Essentials

In this role, success is driven by cognitive abilities such as concentration and problem-solving, essential for our computer-centric tasks. onX will explore reasonable accommodations to ensure that individuals with diverse abilities can fully engage in and contribute to the essential physical and mental functions of the job. If you need assistance or accommodation, please contact us at PC@onxmaps.com.

Position open until filled.

At onX, we believe that unique perspectives make us stronger.
By bringing together people with different experiences, ideas, and viewpoints, we fuel innovation and move closer to our mission of awakening the adventurer in everyone. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to fairness not only in hiring, but also in development, compensation, and promotion. Our goal is to build an inclusive community where every team member can show up authentically and thrive. Together, we win as one team. Come join us!

Forming Our Future together

FormFactor, Inc. (NASDAQ: FORM), is a leading provider of essential test and measurement technologies along the full semiconductor product life cycle — from characterization, modeling, reliability, and design de-bug, to qualification and production test. Semiconductor companies rely upon FormFactor’s products and services to accelerate profitability by optimizing device performance and advancing yield knowledge. The company serves customers through its network of facilities in Asia, Europe, and North America.

Rooted in our core values — Focus on the Customer, Ownership & Accountability, Respectfully & Effectively Communicate, and Motivate & Develop People — we foster an environment where diverse perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated. Everyone can make an impact here. Whether it's improving products, supporting customers, or positively influencing peers and the community, the contributions of our people matter.

Shift

The regular hours for this position are day shift.

Job Description

The Director, Advanced Product Engineering
will drive the development and delivery of advanced cooling solutions for probe card technologies. This role is responsible for defining technical vision and roadmap for thermal solutions, leading multiple engineering efforts, and ensuring alignment with product, manufacturing, and business objectives.

The individual will lead and scale a high-performing engineering team, develop critical capabilities, and drive innovation in cooling architectures for next generation semiconductor test systems. Success in this role requires a balance of deep domain expertise, organizational leadership, and the ability to influence across functions and levels.

Key Responsibilities

Lead the architecture, design, and development of cooling solutions for probe card technologies.
Define and own thermal technology strategy and multi-year roadmap aligned to business objectives.
Lead, develop, and scale a team of engineers.
Drive resource planning, prioritization, and organizational design to support product and technology goals.
Establish and track business and engineering Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and manage development programs using Product Life Cycle (PLC) methodology.
Develop and evaluate new concepts for heat removal, temperature uniformity, and thermal stability.
Ensure organization has the technical rigor to execute development and implementation of solutions for highly complex product and engineering challenges.
Technically lead and/or execute engineering projects and spearhead research and development of new technologies, as appropriate.
Lead escalation resolution for critical product and customer issues. Interface with internal and external stakeholders to resolve complex engineering issues and meet customer commitments.
Collaborate with manufacturing to build prototypes, alpha and beta probe cards.
Drive continuous improvement across development process, manufacturability, and reliability. Own delivery of complex programs including schedule, cost, and technical performance outcomes.

Preferred Experience

MS or Ph.D. in Mechanical Engineering, or a related engineering field preferred; BS with significant relevant experience will also be considered.
10+ years of relevant experience in thermal management, electronics cooling, semiconductor equipment, or related advanced product development environments.
Demonstrated success leading engineering teams in semiconductor, electronics cooling, or related industries.

Skills

3D Modeling, Agile Systems, AutoCAD 3D, Business Acumen, Communication, Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD), Cross-Functional Collaboration, Cross-Functional Leadership, Engineering Leadership, Error Budgets, FEA Software, Geometric Dimensioning And Tolerancing (GD&T), Heat Transfers, Interpersonal Communication, Leadership, MATLAB, Problem Solving, Product Development, Python (Programming Language), Semiconductor Manufacturing, SolidWorks, Technology Strategy Development, Thermal Management, Thermomechanical Processing

If you are looking for a challenging and exciting career in the world of technology, then look no further. Skyworks is an innovator of high-performance analog semiconductors whose solutions are powering the wireless networking revolution. Through our broad technology expertise and one of the most extensive product portfolios in the industry, we are Connecting Everyone and Everything, All the Time.

We are excited about the opportunity to work with you and glad you want to be part of a team of talented individuals who together are changing the way the world communicates.

Description

Skyworks’s Broad Market business unit is seeking a Director of Firmware Engineering
to lead its global wireless engineering team as it moves into the next generation of connectivity platforms focused on higher throughputs, lower latencies and native AI acceleration. As the lead for this team, you will drive the architecture and design of a multi-system firmware spanning disparate domains of control (comms, audio, ai and applications) and drive modularity, testability and scalability into the overall development process. The ideal individual should have prior experience in system architecture, inter-processor communication techniques, device drivers and deep knowledge of wireless MAC and PHY protocols in ISM band. Prior experience developing AI stacks on a compute accelerator along with deploying 1 st party models into customer base is a desirable skill. Occasional travel is required. These Skyworks products are targeted at ultra-low latency audio over wireless and other industrial IOT markets wherever low latency and determinism is required

Responsibilities

Lead software/firmware design and development across US and India locations
Work closely with senior leadership to plan new product introductions into market
Drive best practices in software development, CI/CD, bug tracking and development methodologies
Drive adoption of AI tools for productivity enhancements including agentic flows for coding, debugging and testing
Push team towards organic innovation and generate IP in the process
Plan projects and partner with Program Management and deliver on time and with quality

Required Experience And Skills

BS EE required, MSEE preferred
15+ years of experience building, developing, and leading high-performing software/firmware teams
Experience in embedded software design, development and debugging in C/C++ in a resource constrained environment
Experience with hardware bring-up and validation and on-chip debug
Presenting complex engineering topics to broad audience in clear & concise manner
Act as Project Engineer (PE) at times of the project to drive completion to milestones
Experience with build tools including make, assemblers, compliers, linkers
Experience working with AI models integration with customer facing applications using on-device Neural accelerator

Expertise in system design/architecture while leading large organization across GEOs
Working knowledge of standard hardware protocols (e.g., I2C, SPI, UART, USB) and other BSP drivers (e.g., boot, security, GPIOs)
Working knowledge of audio interface standards and concerns/pitfalls
Experience with wireless protocols (upper layers down to MAC and PHY) in the unlicensed band. Knowledge of WiFi and BT is desirable
Experience with the ARM or RISC-V in CPUs and CEVA or Tensilica in DSP.

Description

Seven Seas Water Group
(SSWG) delivers more than 20 billion gallons of water a year to industrial, governmental, municipal, and hospitality customers across the U.S., Caribbean, and Latin America. Through our Water-as-a-Service® (WaaS®) model, we design, build, own, and operate more than 200 water and wastewater treatment plants, taking on the capital and operational risk so our customers don't have to. SSWG is a portfolio company of EQT, a purpose-driven global investment organization with more than three decades of experience supporting portfolio companies in achieving sustainable growth, operational excellence and market leadership.

What You'll Own

You'll run the day-to-day of the engineering department: setting priorities, managing the team's workload, and making sure every drawing and document that goes out the door is right the first time. You'll be a technical voice in front of customers during business development, building the estimates and preliminary designs that win projects. You'll work closely with Project Management and Construction to standardize our designs, so plants get built faster and cleaner. This isn't a hands-off management job. We need someone who still knows the work well enough to jump in, make the tough call, and mentor a team that respects the decision.

Requirements

What you bring

A bachelor's degree in chemical, Environmental, Civil Engineering, or a related field
5 to 10 years in engineering, with real time on wastewater or municipal projects
5 years managing engineers, whether on a project or department level
A Texas PE license, or the ability to get one within 6 months
Deep fluency in municipal water and wastewater processes, and working knowledge of the mechanical, process, electrical, and I&C disciplines around them
Comfort owning the full design document set (mass balance, PFDs, P&IDs, equipment arrangements) and the document control discipline that keeps a project on track
A PMP is a plus, not a requirement

How To Apply

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. At Quickbase, our mission is to help organizations tackle complexity and move faster by empowering anyone to build solutions. We're seeking a VP of Engineering to raise the bar on how we run our engineering organization, accelerate innovation across the core Quickbase platform, and help shape how AI becomes part of both our products and the way we build software.

In the near term, their primary focus will be the core Quickbase platform - strengthening execution and operational excellence while partnering closely with Product to shape and deliver AI capabilities that create meaningful customer value. As we evolve how we build software ourselves, this leader will partner closely with the engineering leader driving our agentic engineering transformation, helping teams adopt effective AI development practices and translating that work into operating practices, expectations, and metrics across the broader engineering organization. Reporting to the CTO and partnering with the leadership team, this executive will combine strong product and technical leadership with operational excellence and cutting edge agentic development - building a high-performing, globally distributed engineering organization capable of evolving the core platform and supporting new product opportunities over time.

Own Operational Excellence for Quickbase: Bring a fresh, outside perspective to how we run our core platform. Raise the bar on reliability, scalability, security, and delivery predictability — establishing the operational rigor and metrics that let Quickbase scale confidently and run efficiently.

This role will oversee product strategy, strengthen Product Owner capability, and ensure product investments are clearly connected to business, regulatory, member, provider, and operational outcomes.

Oversee the Product Owner community across value streams by establishing product management standards, building product capabilities and driving consistent operating discipline across teams.

Scale and mature product operating models by strengthening backlog management, clarifying Product Owner decision authority, enhancing discovery practices, improving roadmap management and advancing the organization’s transition from project-based to product-based delivery.

Reinforce agile delivery discipline across value streams, including sprint ceremonies, backlog refinement and definition of ready/done.
Create executive visibility into product portfolio health, roadmap progress, delivery risks, priorities, tradeoffs and Product Owner development for IT and business leadership.
Perform other job-related duties as required or assigned.

Demonstrated experience operating within a product-led organization, including ownership of outcomes, roadmaps, prioritization decisions, and discovery practices within an established product operating model.
Knowledge in a healthcare payer or health plan product management.
Familiarity with payer core administrative systems (QNXT, Amisys, or comparable payer systems).
Working knowledge of eligibility, claims, enrollment, care management, HEDIS, CMS regulatory requirements, and value-based care contracting.
Proven ability to coach and develop product talent, raise the effectiveness of Product Owners, and scale consistent product practices across teams.

Understanding of data as a product capability, including building data products, governing data quality as a product discipline, and connecting analytics to business outcomes.

Hands-on fluency with product and delivery tooling such as Jira, including the ability to inspect backlog structure, epic/story hierarchy, workflows, and reporting to reinforce disciplined ways of working.
Working knowledge of Azure and Azure DevOps, along with demonstrated fluency evaluating and applying AI/generative-AI capabilities within product, data, and delivery workflows.
Successful completion of Health Care Sanctions background check.

Bachelor's degree in Business, Health Administration, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent experience).
A minimum of eight years of product management experience, including three or more years in a product leadership role overseeing other product managers or product owners.
Direct healthcare payer/health plan product management experience required, including exposure to a payer core administrative system (QNXT, Amisys, or comparable payer systems).
Experience leading a product team through a project-to-product transformation preferred.
Value-based care, risk adjustment, or Medicare/Medicaid program administration experience preferred.
Familiarity with agile delivery at scale, including Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) or equivalent, sprint ceremonies, backlog refinement, and definition of ready/done.

96643

NextEra Energy Resources is one of America’s largest wholesale electricity generators, harnessing diverse energy sources to power progress. We deliver tailored energy solutions that fuel economic growth, strengthen communities, and help customers achieve their energy goals. Ready to make a lasting impact? Take the next step in your career with us!

Position Specific Description

The Senior Manager – Technology Solutions
provides technical leadership, solution architecture, and delivery oversight for strategic technology initiatives supporting NextEra’s Power Generation fleet. This role partners with business leaders, architecture, product teams, engineering, and delivery organizations to define technology strategies, recommend solution approaches, and lead execution of complex technology programs.

The successful candidate is an experienced technology leader who has designed and delivered enterprise-scale solutions. They combine strong technical expertise with proven program execution experience, ensuring solutions are strategically aligned, technically sound, and operationally supportable. This role bridges business strategy, technology architecture, and delivery execution to drive measurable business outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

Partner with business and IT leadership to understand business objectives and translate them into practical technology solutions.
Lead end-to-end solution architecture for complex technology initiatives, from business concept through production implementation.
Evaluate technology options and recommend scalable, secure, and supportable solutions that align with enterprise standards and long-term application strategy.
Define integration needs across enterprise applications, operational technologies, and third-party systems.
Assess emerging technologies and recommend solutions based on business value, implementation complexity, operational support, and total cost of ownership.
Provide technical leadership, architectural governance, and lead cross-functional teams across multiple strategic technology programs.
Ensure delivered solutions meet performance, reliability, scalability, security, and operational support requirements.
Serve as a trusted technology advisor to both PGD and IT partners providing guidance on technology investments and strategic initiatives.
Present technical recommendations, solution alternatives, and implementation risks.

Experience

10+ years of experience designing, implementing, and leading complex enterprise technology solutions.
Proven success leading large-scale technology implementations from strategy through production deployment.
Strong experience in solution architecture, enterprise integrations, cloud technologies, application modernization, and technology lifecycle management.
Demonstrated expertise implementing Databricks-based solutions and modern cloud data platforms to enable scalable, secure, and high-performing business capabilities.
Experience architecting and delivering technology solutions that leverage large-scale operational data, IoT/OT platforms, and enterprise system integrations to support mission-critical business operations.
Proven ability to evaluate technology alternatives and recommend solutions that balance business value, scalability, operational support, security, and long-term sustainability.
Experience leading cross-functional technical teams and influencing architectural decisions across complex enterprise environments.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to translate business needs into actionable technology solutions.

Semarchy was founded in 2011 in Lyon, France, by a team of passionate data experts with a clear mission: modernizing master data management. Semarchy’s Snowflake Native App achieved proven product-market fit in Year One of the partnership, with multiple enterprise wins already on the books. Rapid growth in pipeline, awareness, and interest — combined with the joint Semarchy/Snowflake roadmap — is creating a major scaling opportunity for 2026 and beyond.
The Sr. Director, Product and Technology Partnerships is a unique hybrid leadership role that sits at the intersection of product and partnerships. You will own two tightly connected missions: driving deep technical and product alignment with our strategic technology partners — initially with Snowflake and Microsoft — and driving product management for Semarchy’s Snowflake-native solutions so that our roadmap and our partners’ platforms advance together as one strategy.
This role is strictly focused on technical alignment with partners — product roadmaps, platform capabilities, integrations, and joint solution architecture — not on commercial or sales plays, which are owned by our alliance and sales teams. That said, you must bring strong commercial savvy: an understanding of go-to-market practices and the ability to work effectively with product, product marketing, marketing, and sales so that technical alignment translates into market impact.
You will report to the Chief Product Officer, with a dotted-line relationship to the Head of Product Management (based in France) for your product management responsibilities. Snowflake is our most mature partnership and the immediate priority, with Microsoft — where our technology works with Microsoft Fabric and Purview — as the second strategic focus. Beyond these, this role owns Semarchy’s broader technology partnership strategy and will explore potential technical alignment with other technology vendors across the data and AI ecosystem.
This is a senior individual contributor role to start, with the opportunity to build and lead a team as the partnership portfolio scales. It is built for someone with high agency: a builder who creates structure, drives follow-through, and earns the trust of partner product and engineering organizations.
Location:
USA, remote, in the Central or Eastern time zone. You will collaborate daily with our product and engineering teams in France and coordinate regularly with technology partners primarily based in the western USA, so working hours that bridge both are essential.

Must Have
10+ years in enterprise software, including 5+ years in technical partnerships, partner engineering, solutions leadership, or product management roles within cloud ecosystems.
Proven success driving technical and product alignment with one or more of: Snowflake, Microsoft/Azure, or other major cloud data platforms.
Hands-on product management experience: gathering requirements, writing specifications, managing a backlog, and partnering with engineering to ship.
Deep working knowledge of the modern data stack (cloud data platforms, data management, integration, or analytics).
Commercial savvy: a strong understanding of go-to-market practices and the ability to work effectively with product, product marketing, marketing, and sales teams.
Comfortable operating across technology, product, and executive relationships, including with senior partner product and engineering leaders.
Strong program management skills and high agency — driven to get things done; elite communication and soft skills, including the ability to translate technical depth for commercial audiences.
Based in the US Central or Eastern time zone, with the flexibility to overlap with teams in France (mornings) and partners on the US West Coast (afternoons); willingness to travel (~25%) for partner meetings, customer engagements, and industry events.

Direct experience with Snowflake Native Apps, Snowpark, or building solutions on the Snowflake Marketplace.
Experience with the Microsoft Partner ecosystem and marketplaces.
Domain expertise in master data management (MDM), data integration, data products, semantic intelligence.
Experience working in a globally distributed organization across US and European time zones; French language skills are a plus.
Experience building and leading partner engineering or product teams.

As the portfolio scales, help define the team needed to support it, with the opportunity to hire and lead.

Drive product management for Semarchy’s partner-aligned solutions — expanding our Snowflake-aligned capabilities and our alignment with Microsoft Fabric — working day-to-day with the Head of Product Management and engineering teams in France.
Gather and synthesize requirements from customers, partners, partner field teams, analysts, and competitive intelligence into a prioritized roadmap for the Snowflake Native App and related capabilities.
